Facebook (FB) Shareholder Centaur Capital Partners LP Has Increased Position; Davis Capital Partners Increased Its Wells Fargo & Co. New (WFC) Position by $1.50 Million
May 26, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Zeke Ashton increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 70.59% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Centaur Capital Partners Lp bought 6,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund run by Zeke Ashton held 14,500 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.56 million, up from 8,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Centaur Capital Partners Lp who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $535.28 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.54% or $1.01 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 9.79 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Davis Capital Partners Llc increased its stake in Wells Fargo & Co. New (WFC) by 1.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Davis Capital Partners Llc bought 25,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.98% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.50 million shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $91.01 million, up from 1.48M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Davis Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Wells Fargo & Co. New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $267.52 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.42% or $0.23 during the last trading session, reaching $54.9. About 17.74 million shares traded. Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) has declined 7.75% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.30% the S&P500.
Centaur Capital Partners Lp, which manages about $166.13 million and $63.09 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Spdr S&P 500 Etf Tr (Call) (SPY) by 3,500 shares to 27,500 shares, valued at $7.34 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Usa Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:USAT) by 137,500 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 112,500 shares, and cut its stake in Mix Telematics Ltd (NYSE:MIXT).
